entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 85670: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85670: distance 116.55 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.012), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 116.55 +/- 1.399 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 85670 (same row): -15.89, 12.28 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, HIP 85670: RV -21 +/- 0.23 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 40.284 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85670: radius 40.284 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 996.471 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.05) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5113 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85670: effective temperature 5113 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.049).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 159181: 168-1020 nm, cross-checked against Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Rastaban is HR 6536. (7 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe9cc. Routes tried in order: gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; kiehling: HR 6536 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; burnashev: BS 6536 is not in part2; stis-ngsl: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,113 K and log g 2.05 (u1 0.591, u2 0.172): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.05 from 2024A&A...692A.189R; the 24 published values span log g 1.35 to 2.05, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.6% of the centre brightness.
